d: Short, charcoal-grey hair is styled in a choppy, layered cut with long bangs swept across the forehead. The eyes are a deep charcoal grey with a neutral, slightly wide-eyed expression on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender, dressed in a red long-sleeved sailor-style top with a dark brown collar and a matching dark brown bow, paired with short red bottoms. Attached to the body are several grey metallic naval turret components and gun batteries.
